hero.headline: Full-Stack Development for Businesses & Products
hero.valueProposition: I build web applications, SaaS products, and business systems — and add AI where it makes the product smarter or more efficient.

image.alt: Portrait of Tayyab Shahzad, full-stack developer

about.who: I'm a full-stack developer focused on building practical software products and business systems. I work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, deployment, and integrations — with AI added when it genuinely improves the product.
about.interestedIn: I care about software that solves real operational problems: ordering systems, admin dashboards, SaaS products, and workflows that replace fragmented tools.
about.whatIBuild: I build full-stack web applications, SaaS products, business management systems, APIs, and custom software. AI features are added when they create measurable value — not as a default label.
about.headingTowards: I want to keep shipping production software that businesses can rely on day to day — clear requirements, solid engineering, and honest delivery.

footer.statement: Full-stack development for web applications, SaaS products, and business systems.

contact.headline: Have a product or business system in mind?
contact.subheadline: Tell me what you're trying to build. I'll help turn the requirements into a practical technical solution.
contact.note: I work on web applications, SaaS products, business systems, APIs, and AI-powered features inside full-stack products.
